notes: Amgen paid $1.9B for Five Prime's bemarituzumab — an anti-FGFR2b monoclonal antibody for FGFR2b-overexpressing gastric / GEJ adenocarcinoma. Phase 2 FIGHT data was positive at deal time (PFS benefit in biomarker-selected patients). Phase 3 FORTITUDE-101 and FORTITUDE-102 launched post-close; PFS readout in 2024-2025. Peak sales estimate $1B reflects analyst consensus for the biomarker-selected gastric cancer population (~30% of advanced gastric tumors express FGFR2b at high level). Targeted-therapy framing — comparable to other biomarker-defined oncology mAbs.
selection_rationale: Smaller-deal anchor for the oncology-mAb/ADC cohort. Phase 2 single-asset, biomarker-defined, mid-cap acquirer (Amgen). Triangulates with Immunomedics (post-approval, large deal) and Forty Seven (Phase 2, larger deal but novel mechanism). Three deals spanning $1.9B-$21B and Phase 2 through approval gives a meaningful EV/peak range for the cohort.
source: Amgen press release Mar 4 2021; Five Prime SEC filings; Amgen Q2-Q3 2024 earnings (FORTITUDE-101 enrollment progress disclosure).
